title: Warnings of Scripture
definition: The warnings of Scripture are God's serious and gracious calls that expose danger, confront sin, guard faith, and urge repentance.
summary: God's warnings are acts of mercy that call people away from destruction and toward life.
christFocus: Jesus warned because He loves, calling sinners to repentance and His people to watchfulness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture contains warnings because sin is dangerous and judgment is real. Warnings are not contrary to grace; they are one way God protects and awakens people.

Biblical warnings confront complacency, unbelief, hypocrisy, false assurance, temptation, and rebellion. They call people to repentance and perseverance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people only want comforting passages and ignore Scripture's warnings. This doctrine matters because love tells the truth about danger.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive warnings humbly. Do not harden your heart when Scripture confronts you. Let God's warnings lead you to repentance, vigilance, and renewed trust in Christ.
